cells.name: picnic-source
cells.prompt: Antique black and white photograph from 1952 of a family picnic on a lakeside meadow in summer, wide shot with plenty of open grass around them: a grandfather and a grandmother seated on a checkered blanket, a mother kneeling beside a wicker basket, a father standing in a straw hat, a girl of six and a boy of nine standing next to the blanket, a small dog lying in the grass, a calm lake and tall poplars behind, everyone looking at the camera with soft closed-lip smiles, shot on a box camera
